name: instant-api — github_webhook_received bad_signature elevated [spoofing or secret mismatch]
description: P2/abuse. Fires when instant_github_webhook_received_total{result="bad_signature"} rate is elevated over ~10m. A non-zero bad_signature count means one of: (a) an attacker is probing the /webhooks/github endpoint with forged payloads (spoofing), (b) the GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET in instant-secrets has drifted from the secret configured in the GitHub App settings — the most common cause after a secret rotation on one side only, (c) a third-party tool is forwarding GitHub webhooks to the wrong endpoint with the wrong secret. Cross-correlate against NR Logs for api service message='github.webhook.bad_signature' which carries the delivery_id, x-github-event, and the client IP. If the rate tracks with a single IP or delivery_id range, treat as an active spoofing attempt; rotate the webhook secret immediately and update both instant-secrets (kubectl) and the GitHub App webhook settings. If it tracks with a legitimate GitHub delivery ID and no IP anomaly, treat as secret mismatch: re-sync GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Source: api/internal/handlers/github_webhook.go; counter registered in api/internal/metrics/metrics.go as instant_github_webhook_received_total{event,result}. Lazy metric — bad_signature label series only appears after the first malformed delivery.

nrql.query: SELECT sum(instant_github_webhook_received_total) FROM Metric WHERE metricName = 'instant_github_webhook_received_total' AND result = 'bad_signature'
